verdict.rationale: Semgrep has explicit first-party documentation for a pre-commit framework integration ('The pre-commit framework can run semgrep when you commit changes... preventing secrets and security issues from leaking into your Git history'), and GitHub also confirms it 'can run in an IDE, as a pre-commit check, and as part of CI/CD workflows.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on community confirmation specifically of the pre-commit hook workflow (community evidence covers CI/general usage but not pre-commit specifically).
